mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 76 degrees at Harriet Park under clear skies with an air quality index of 53, while the moon is currently a waning crescent; tonight will cool down to a low of 72 with rain expected overnight.

The city is moving forward with development projects including a site plan at 201 South Main Street, and our local student body recently participated in a creative contest to design the official I Voted stickers for November.

Enjoy yoga today, followed by a full lineup tomorrow including trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus the Downtown Farmer's Market and more trivia at The Mill and The Bogey Factory on August 12.
On August 6, an officer conducted a traffic stop that resulted in the arrest of a 49-year-old man for his fourth O W I offence.

Today's flavor is the delicious Georgia Peach, and since the shop is closing in less than 60 minutes, you will want to get there soon; if you miss out, remember that tomorrow's flavor is Chocolate Heath Crunch.
